description: Read one published dataset (the JSON behind a chart), e.g. "sp500/drawdowns", "sp500/pe", "ndx/forward-pe", "recessions". Rows can be filtered by `since`/`until` on their `date` (or `year`). A result is capped at about 60,000 characters: when a file is larger (long daily series), each array keeps its most recent rows and the cut is reported under `windowed`. Scalars and summary fields are always included.

path.description: Dataset path without /api/ and .json, as returned by search_charts.

since.description: Keep rows dated on or after this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

tail.description: Rows kept per array after filtering, from the end. By default every row is returned when the result fits; long daily series are cut to their most recent rows and reported under `windowed`.

until.description: Keep rows dated on or before this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

name: get_dataset
title: Read a dataset
